levels.goal: Identify inputs, outputs, state, dependencies and possible side effects.
Explain behavior while distinguishing inspected structure from executed result.
Write a bounded pure function from an explicit contract.
Write normal, edge, failure and regression tests.
Preserve a failing case, identify cause, repair and retest the same case.
Implement legal transitions and reject illegal transitions without silent fallback.
Translate representations without taking source or target authority.
Recognize data, permission, filesystem, network, process and execution boundaries.
Migrate schemas while retaining old readable history and rollback.

promotion_rule: Static PASS never grants execution authority. Runtime competence requires a later separate execution lab and repeated unseen tests.
truth_boundary: Code remains an action proposal until an explicit execution gate runs it.
